integrity: Analytical proof plus executable corroborating tests; bibliographic priority not independently verified.
scientific_limitations: Sharp dimensional growth order, not the exact finite-N extremal constant. Two unweighted rows from an orthonormal two-column real matrix; no finite-precision or complete Krylov-method guarantee. Known general E/K design distinction is not claimed as new.
title: A sharp-order E-versus-K row-selection gap for two-dimensional orthonormal frames
